data.name: Tandemonium
data.detailed_description:
Tandemonium — One tandem bike. Two riders. Total pandemonium.

Coordinate pedaling on a shared tandem bicycle where your pedals are 180° apart. Sync up for maximum speed, or clash and wobble into glorious disaster. It's physics-based co-op chaos at its finest.

Key Features:

- Real Tandem Physics — A shared crank means you must coordinate opposite pedal strokes. Perfect sync = turbo power. Same foot at the same time = you're going nowhere fast.

- Online Co-op Multiplayer — Ride together over peer-to-peer with built-in voice and video chat. Watch your partner panic as you tip.

- Captain & Stoker Roles — The Captain and the Stoker steer, balance and power the pedals. Both must work together or crash spectacularly.

- Multiple Input Methods — Keyboard, gamepad joystick or gyro, or have a friend play on mobile and tilt their phone as a motion controller for an immersive lean experience for everyone.

- Two Courses — Sprint to Grandma's House or endure the long road to The Castle, collecting presents and gems along the way.

- 7 Unique Bikes — From Grandma's Classic to the Banana Delivery, each with its own personality. Unlock holiday bikes through achievements.

- Dynamic Difficulty — Safety Mode for beginners, Daredevil for veterans, and adaptive difficulty that meets you where you are.

- 19 Achievements — Earn badges for speed, distance, flawless rides, perfect sync, and more. Your earned badges orbit your rider for all to see.

- Clip Recording — Save and share your best wipeouts and photo finishes with picture-in-picture compositing video/audio.

- Leaderboards — Track your times solo, together, and by role. Who's the better Captain?

Published by Users First (Games) —

data.short_description: Two riders. One bike. Total chaos. Tandemonium is a physics-based tandem racing game where two players share a crank with pedals 180° apart. Sync strokes for speed or clash into wobbling chaos. Play solo or ride online together with built-in voice and video chat.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 / AMD dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 630 or equivalent (WebGL 2.0 required)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Internet required for multiplayer, authentication, and leaderboards. Supports Xbox and PlayStation controllers.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires an Apple processor
  • OS: macOS 11 (Big Sur)
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 GPU or dedicated GPU
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
  • Additional Notes: Internet required for multiplayer, authentication, and leaderboards. Supports PlayStation controller.
